text:
emma: Heads-up: planning to lift feature flag `smart_cache` to 20% at 13:00 PT today. Need someone to own the rollout and smoke checks. Target window 13:00-13:20. /cc @sanjay @leo

sanjay: I can own the rollout. I'll trigger the flag and watch dashboards. Plan: start at 5% for warmup then bump to 20% after we see steady p95. :thumbsup:

leo: I can run the smoke script and trace checks. Quick smoke steps I'll run:```bash
# smoke steps
curl -s https://api.redwood.internal/health | jq .
python infra/tools/smoke.py --profile=smart_cache --sample 20
# check traces
# query: service:api env:prod span.name:response latency.p95>200ms
```

cassie: Agree on safe defaults — set fallback to `legacy_cache` and enable safemode fallback toggle. If errors spike we should auto-fallback. Suggested config change: `redwoodctl feature update smart_cache --fallback=legacy_cache --enable-safemode true`

deploy-bot: Scheduled change: `smart_cache` flag adjustment at 2026-03-17T20:00:00Z (13:00 PT) by sanjay. Runbook: <https://redwood.internal/runbooks/flag-rollout#smart_cache|runbook>

sanjay: Rollout checklist (I'll follow):
1) set `smart_cache`=5%
2) wait 3m; validate p50/p95 and error rate
3) if stable, bump to 20%
4) monitor for 10m post-bump
Rollback cmd: `redwoodctl feature set smart_cache --percent 0` (immediate)

leo: Alerts to watch: Datadog monitors `api.latency.smart_cache.p95`, `api.errors.rate`, and the new trace sampling. I'll post a short dashboard link before start.

cassie: I'll be on standby for rollback. Thresholds: >2% relative increase in errors over 5m OR p95 increase >50ms triggers rollback. Also verify KV cache hit rate doesn't drop.

emma: Thanks — sanjay, can you confirm ~10m before start so I can pause other non-critical jobs in the window?

sanjay: Confirmed. I'll post a "started" message at the 5% change and a "complete" once 20% is stable. ETA: start 13:00 PT.

deploy-bot: sanjay moved `smart_cache` -> 5% (1770004386). Reaction :rocket:

sanjay: 5% live. Initial checks: p95 = 120ms (baseline 115ms), errors +0.1% — proceeding to monitor for 3m.

leo: Quick note: if you see |trace.span:cache.lookup| latency spike, toggle `safemode=true` and hold. Command: `redwoodctl feature update smart_cache --safemode true`

cassie: Standing by. If we need to rollback I'll run the command and confirm in thread.

sanjay: Bumping to 20% now. Will report back in 5m.

sanjay: 20% live. p95 130ms, errors +0.4% — within thresholds, continuing 10m watch.

emma: Great work team — leave notes in the runbook under the rollout section after you finish. :white_check_mark:
